verdict.rationale: Visa publishes versioned REST endpoints (e.g. /acp/v1/instructions, /acp/v1/tokens) with detailed required-field documentation and a self-serve sandbox for testing (visa-ic-supp-3, visa-ic-supp-4, visa-ic-supp-5, visa-ic-supp-10), and the separate Trusted Agent Protocol ships a public spec plus a runnable reference implementation with signature-verification tooling (cdn-proxy RFC9421 verification) (visa-ic-supp-9, visa-ic-supp-6). However, there's no single published formal schema (OpenAPI/JSON-schema) artifact or a dedicated conformance/validation test suite for the overall Intelligent Commerce protocol beyond the sandbox and TAP reference code. missing for 10: a published machine-readable schema/spec file for the ACP endpoints, and an explicit conformance test suite/validator distinct from the sandbox and TAP demo repo.
